strongest_angle: Explore the congressional commission process and institutional formation dynamics as Philadelphia's Weitzman National Museum of American Jewish History seeks to join the Smithsonian Institution network.

key_facts.fact: Philadelphia's Weitzman National Museum of American Jewish History is advancing its bid to join the Smithsonian Institution network as a new congressional commission studies the potential transfer.

Members of a new congressional commission tasked with studying whether to make the Weitzman Museum part of the Smithsonian were sworn in on Tuesday according to reports by the Jewish Telegraphic Agency.
key_facts.source_name: J. The Jewish News of Northern California

key_facts.fact: The Weitzman National Museum of American Jewish History is pursuing its inclusion in the Smithsonian Institution during a period of significant upheaval and political tensions for the storied museum network.
